title: QuickChat: FastReplies
description: Adds timestamps and a hotkey (R) for a quick /msg setup
body:
✨ QuickChat
QuickChat is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod that supercharges your Minecraft chat experience with styled messages, timestamps, and instant replies — all without any hassle.

🚀 Features
⏱️ Timestamps on Every Message
Never lose track of when something was said. QuickChat automatically overlays the time each message was received directly in your HUD, formatted in a clean HH:mm style.
🎨 Styled Chat Names
Chat messages get a visual glow-up — sender names are highlighted and formatted to stand out at a glance, making busy multiplayer servers much easier to read.
⚡ Instant Quick-Reply (Press R)
Spotted a message you want to reply to? Just press R to instantly address the last person who messaged you in chat — no typing their name manually, no fumbling through chat history. One key, and you're replying.

📦 Requirements
DependencyVersionMinecraft1.21.11Fabric Loader≥ 0.18.4Fabric APIAnyJava21+

🔧 Installation

Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.11
Download Fabric API
Drop quickchat-1.21.11+1.1.jar into your mods/ folder
Launch and enjoy smarter chat!
